procedure.name: CPU1
procedure.statement: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT MD5(CONCAT(MD5(CONCAT(MD5(CONCAT(MD5(CONCAT(MD5(CONCAT(passwd,?)),?)),?)),?)),?)) FROM cputable WHERE empid >= 0 AND empid < 100) T1

procedure.name: CPU2
procedure.statement: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT MD5(CONCAT(MD5(CONCAT(MD5(CONCAT(MD5(CONCAT(MD5(CONCAT('passwd',?)),?)),?)),?)),?)) FROM cputable WHERE empid >= 0 AND empid < 100) T2
